newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Nov leading index 77.8, coincident 100.
newsitem.headline: Japan Nov leading index 77.8, coincident 100.

text.p: Japan's diffusion index of leading economic indicators stood at 77.8 on a scale of 100 in November, staying above the so-called "boom or bust" mark of 50 for a third consecutive month, the Economic Planning Agency said on Friday.
A breakdown of the indices of economic indicators follows:
The EPA said in statement that the data showed Japan's economy was continuing to recover.
A figure for the leading index above 50 is generally taken as suggesting the economy will expand in the coming months.
The coincident index measures current economic conditions, while the lagging index traces economic trends in the past few months.
It was the third month in a row that both leading and coincident indices had simultaneously been above 50, the EPA said. The lagging index was above 50 for a second consecutive month.
